name: @forge/types
description: Shared TypeScript types describing the FORGE Business OS API contract (error envelope, pagination envelope, the frozen UserRole enum mirror). Hand-maintained — keep in sync with Document 5 (Backend/API Specification) and prisma/schema.prisma. Consumed by apps/web and @forge/api-client; deliberately not consumed by apps/api (see docs/IMPLEMENTATION-PHASE-0.md for why).
